#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs in eclipse-temurin:21-jdk, /w mounted with sbe-all-1.33.0.jar,
# spot-fixsbe-1_1.xml and BinanceCheck.java: generates Real Logic's Java
# codecs of Binance's schema, compiles them with BinanceCheck, and writes
# binance.hex and binance-sofh.hex.
set -euo pipefail
cd /w
JAR=/w/sbe-all-1.33.0.jar
OPENS="--add-opens java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED --add-opens java.base/java.nio=ALL-UNNAMED --add-exports java.base/jdk.internal.misc=ALL-UNNAMED"
rm -rf gen classes && mkdir -p gen classes
java -Dsbe.output.dir=gen -Dsbe.target.language=Java -Dsbe.validation.stop.on.error=true -Dsbe.validation.warnings.fatal=false \
  -jar "$JAR" spot-fixsbe-1_1.xml
javac -cp "$JAR" -d classes $(find gen -name '*.java') BinanceCheck.java
java $OPENS -cp "$JAR:classes" BinanceCheck > binance.hex
java $OPENS -cp "$JAR:classes" BinanceCheck sofh > binance-sofh.hex
wc -l binance.hex binance-sofh.hex
